exposure: Precocious exposure to the ex-utero environment
cohort: The study included preterm pigs delivered via c-section at 91% term and raised for 10 days, compared to term pigs sacrificed at birth as controls.
finding: Preterm birth and precocious exposure to the ex-utero environment disrupt cerebellar development by modulating the expression of key cerebellar developmental genes, primarily affecting the development of granule precursors and Bergmann glia.
gest_age: Preterm pigs at 91% term; Term pigs (controls)
